notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Available Now for Free!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/6428763e3d9b4152c6bdb8e5f529f05ea666cc4e.png[/img]

We've just released a major update for Chess Knights: High Noon! 

It is a completely new story, with new characters, new mechanics and scenarios.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/932e59cd1eab95ac91260397e1dee183f72ffe74.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/d3d9964dc4753b2e017364f776b6cbefa51aa140.png[/img]

Together with this content update, we've also fixed several minor issues, added a help guide and other features to make the experience great for you.

You can update your game and start playing it right away. 

And if you still does not own a copy of Chess Knights: High Noon, you can get it for only $1.99:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486800/Chess_Knights_High_Noon/

notes.title: THE LOST ONES - FREE EXPANSION AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976374/0a00b7a8270f8abfe051429f433f6f6f61221fc4.jpg[/img]

Hi all!

We are very happy to announce today we are releasing a major expansion to the game called "[b]The Lost Ones[/b]".

After clearing all levels from each region, you will unlock a new set of more difficult levels. In these levels you'll need to rescue some fellows that were left behind in a much dangerous part of the Viking Lands.

Prepare yourself to think hard in order to rescue all the lost ones!

There are [b]20 new levels[/b] in total and we hope you'll have a lot of fun with them :)

[h3]THE  LOST ONES - General Features List
[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]20 New Levels[/b] - Designed to be harder puzzles than the ones in each region;

[*] [b]Controller Support for the Gameplay[/b] - We designed a new user experience for you to play the game using your controller;

[*] [b]New Video Tutorial[/b] - For those new to Chess;

[*] [b]New "Highlight Moves" Feature [/b]-  You can activate this feature in the settings if you need a little help to figure out the allowed movements in each turn;

[*] Some small fixes and general improvements.
[/list]

Here are some images to get you excited:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976374/9b32d53ebcac6dc77ea4d96855aea63b5cc76196.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976374/c26ba54c32366463e8f958359b89fd88b972f9cd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37976374/b3dfd9cf4317714a8ad024bd444b7c0a28d66d75.jpg[/img]


The expansion [b]The Lost Ones [/b]is available now for free. You can get Chess Knights: Viking Lands to play it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1338980/Chess_Knights_Viking_Lands/

We couldn't end this announcement without thanking you for all the love and support to this game! 

We feel privileged to have such an amazing community of players that love puzzle games as much as we do, and that support tiny studios trying to make great little games :)

[b]This free expansion is our "Thank You" note to you. Keep being awesome![/b]
